description:
Orchestration and testing: run many tool calls in one request (optionally atomic, one undo step), wait for game state,
and run automation tests inside the running game (also packaged Development builds).

Batching workflow: run_batch with calls [{tool, arguments}]; later calls can use earlier results with "$N.path"
(e.g. {"parent": "$0.id"}). wait_for_condition polls any tool until a field of its result meets a condition.

Testing workflow (like Epic's AutomationTestToolset):
  1. list_tests to find tests (filter syntax below).
  2. run_automation_test with a filter; tests run over the next frames.
  3. get_test_status (counts, failures) and get_test_results (per test state, duration, errors, warnings) to monitor.
  4. stop_tests to abort.
Filter syntax (several expressions joined by '+', a test matching any of them is selected):
  "StartsWith:RuntimeToolsets.Core" or "^RuntimeToolsets.Core"  prefix of the full test path
  "Undo$"                                                        suffix
  "Schema"                                                       substring anywhere in the path
  "Group:Smoke"                                                  a group from the AutomationControllerSettings Groups config
name: ops

tools.description:
Per-test results of the current or last run started with run_automation_test.
Returns: {run_filter, results:[{test, state, duration_s, errors, warnings}]} in run order. Fails if the filter names an unknown group.

filter.description: Only tests matching this filter expression, e.g. "Undo$"; empty = all.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (0 = default limit).

tools.name: ops.get_test_results

returnValue.description: {run_filter, results:[{test, state, duration_s, errors, warnings}]} in run order. Fails if the filter names an unknown group.

results.description: Per-test results in run order (only tests that started, plus skipped ones after a stop).

run_filter.description: Filter of the run these results belong to.

returnValue.title: OpsToolTestResults

tools.description:
Progress and failures of the current or last test run.
Returns: {running, filter, total, completed, passed, failed, current, failures:[{test, errors}]}. Fails if max_failures is outside 0 - 200.
tools.name: ops.get_test_status

returnValue.description: {running, filter, total, completed, passed, failed, current, failures:[{test, errors}]}. Fails if max_failures is outside 0 - 200.

failures.description: Failed tests in run order (at most max_failures).

filter.description: Filter of the current or last run.

returnValue.title: OpsToolTestStatus

tools.description:
Lists the ready-made scenes and setups (recipes) the installed extensions bring (none in the core plugin): what each builds, which parts can be skipped and how many calls it makes.
Returns: The recipes: name, what they build, parts that can be skipped, number of calls.
tools.name: ops.list_recipes

returnValue.description: The recipes: name, what they build, parts that can be skipped, number of calls.

parts.description: Parts that can be left out with run_recipe skip, e.g. "props".

tools.description:
Lists the automation tests available in this build.
Returns: {total, tests} with full test paths sorted alphabetically. Fails if the filter names an unknown group.

filter.description: Filter expression (see the toolset description), e.g. "^RuntimeToolsets.Toolsets+Group:Smoke"; empty = all.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths returned (0 = default limit).

tools.name: ops.list_tests

returnValue.description: {total, tests} with full test paths sorted alphabetically. Fails if the filter names an unknown group.
returnValue.title: OpsToolTestList

tools.description:
Starts automation tests in-process (also in packaged builds). They run over the next frames, one per frame: poll get_test_status / get_test_results and avoid other world changes meanwhile.
Returns: The run status right after starting. Fails with busy if a run is in progress, with not_found if no test matches.
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.

filter.description: Filter expression (see the toolset description), e.g. "^RuntimeToolsets.Toolsets.Actors".

tools.name: ops.run_automation_test

returnValue.description: The run status right after starting. Fails with busy if a run is in progress, with not_found if no test matches.

failures.description: Failed tests in run order (at most max_failures).

filter.description: Filter of the current or last run.

returnValue.title: OpsToolTestStatus

tools.description:
Runs several tool calls in order in one request. Later calls can reference earlier results: a string argument that is exactly "$N" or "$N.path" becomes that value of call N's result, e.g. {"tool": "actors.spawn_actor", "arguments": {"parent": "$0.id"}} after a scene.create_group call ("$$" writes a literal "$"). With atomic, everything is one undo step and a failure rolls the whole batch back.
Returns: {completed, total, failed_at (-1 = none), history_id (-1 unless atomic), results:[{i, tool, ok, ...}]} in call order. Fails if calls is empty or longer than 100, contains ops.run_batch, or references a call that does not run before it; an atomic batch fails with the failing call's error.

atomic.description: All or nothing: roll every change back if a call fails; one undo step on success.

arguments.description: Arguments object for the tool. A string value "$N" or "$N.path" is replaced by call N's result (e.g. "$0.id"). (Any JSON value)

tool.description: Qualified tool name, e.g. "actors.spawn_actor" ("actors_spawn_actor" works too).

label.description: History label of an atomic batch, e.g. "build village".

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failure (always true when atomic).

tools.name: ops.run_batch

completed.description: Calls that ran (including a failed one).

failed_at.description: Index of the first failed call, -1 if none failed.

history_id.description: History entry of an atomic batch (undo it with history.undo), -1 otherwise.

results.description: One result per call that ran, in order: {i, tool, ok, ...result} or {i, tool, ok:false, error:{code, message, hint}}.

tools.description:
Builds a ready-made scene or setup by running its stored tool calls (like run_batch; it clears the scene first when the recipe says so). Everything it makes is ordinary nodes: change or extend it with the other tools afterwards.
Returns: Like run_batch: {completed, total, failed_at, results} (a recipe keeps going past calls that fail). Fails if the recipe does not exist.
tools.name: ops.run_recipe

completed.description: Calls that ran (including a failed one).

failed_at.description: Index of the first failed call, -1 if none failed.

history_id.description: History entry of an atomic batch (undo it with history.undo), -1 otherwise.

results.description: One result per call that ran, in order: {i, tool, ok, ...result} or {i, tool, ok:false, error:{code, message, hint}}.

tools.description:
Stops the running test run: the current test is stopped and the queued ones are skipped.
Returns: The status after stopping. Fails if no run started by run_automation_test is in progress.
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.
tools.name: ops.stop_tests

returnValue.description: The status after stopping. Fails if no run started by run_automation_test is in progress.

failures.description: Failed tests in run order (at most max_failures).

filter.description: Filter of the current or last run.

returnValue.title: OpsToolTestStatus

tools.description:
Lets the game run for a number of seconds (real time), e.g. after starting physics or an animation.
Returns: {waited_s}. Fails if seconds is outside 0 - 120.
tools.name: ops.wait

tools.description:
Polls a tool until a field of its result meets a condition, or times out. Soft errors of the polled tool (e.g. not_found while an object does not exist yet) count as "not yet"; the path is then evaluated on the error result.
Returns: {met, polls, waited_s, value}. Fails with timeout if the condition is not met in time, with the polled tool's error if it fails with unknown_tool, invalid_arguments, not_allowed or toolset_disabled, and with invalid_arguments if the op needs a value and none is given.

arguments.description: Arguments for the polled tool, e.g. {"target": "n12"}. (Any JSON value)

path.description: Field of the result, e.g. "location[2]" or "level.visible"; empty = the whole result. Fields of a returnValue are found directly too.

timeout_s.description: Give up after this many seconds (0.05 - 300).

value.description: Value to compare with (needed by every op except truthy, exists, not_exists), e.g. 200. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: ops.wait_for_condition

met.description: Always true (a condition that is never met fails the call with a timeout).

polls.description: How many times the tool was called.

value.description: The value found at `path` when the condition was met. (Any JSON value)

waited_s.description: Seconds from the first poll to the one that met the condition.
